37
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, November 30, 2011/Agrahayana 9, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs; Housing
and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Labour and Employment; Textiles;
Urban Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Increasing  dependency of
manufacturing sector on import from
China
†*121. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
75 per cent of India's manufacturing would
be dependent on goods imported from
China by 2014-15;
(b) whether the National Security
Council of the country has expressed
concern over the increasing dependency
over China;
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to make domestic industries
self-dependent and to end the dependency
upon China;
(d) the percentage of export and import
between India and China and the profit
earned by China annually out of it; and
(e) the steps being taken by Government
to bring parity in import and export?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Reduction in customs duty for import
of dry rubber
*122. DR. T. N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
withdraw the permission given to import
dry rubber at reduced rate of customs duty;
and
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to protect the interests of rubber farmers,
in view of the steep fall in demand and price
of natural rubber?
Wear and tear of Delhi Metro lines
*123. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the lines of the Delhi Metro which
have maximum wear and tear;
(b) the reasons therefor and the
corrective action taken in the matter;
(c) the lines of Delhi Metro which are
most zigzag;

38
(d) what are its implications; and
(e) in what way it will be remedied?
Steps to alleviate poverty from urban
areas
*124. SHRI TARUN VIJAY: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of deaths in the country
in the poorer sections of the society due to
malnutrition and starvation and the
immediate steps taken by Government to
tackle the situation;
(b) the steps taken during the last one
year to alleviate poverty from urban areas
and the results thereof; and
(c) the number of poor families in urban
sector and the quantum of their daily food
intake?
Steps to ensure minimum wages to
menial workers
*125. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in Delhi and
other cities, liftmen, sweepers and other
menial workers are not getting minimum
wages;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether contract labourers are
mainly responsible for this situation; and
(d) if so, the measures Government
proposes to take, to ensure minimum
wages, at least in the National Capital?
Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor
*126. SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has given its
final approval for Delhi-Mumbai Industrial
Corridor;
(b) if so, the details thereof and financial
burden which Government is expected to
bear and the time-frame for completion of
the proposed project;
(c) whether the expenditure is being
shared by the Central and the State
Governments, if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the project is being funded
by external/non-Governmental sources;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the reasons for undertaking this
project?
Fencing of defence land in UP and
MP
†*127. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the area of land held by the army in
border areas of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya
Pradesh, particularly in Mahoba and
Chhatarpur districts;
(b) whether villagers are still cultivating
and their cattle are grazing on the defence
land and construction work is also going
on there;
(c) whether there is any plan to fence
the defence land by getting the firing range
vacated in village Dhorra in the district of
Mahoba; and
(d) if so, by when the villagers will be
provided with an alternate thoroughfare
and the details thereof?
Decline in employment growth
*128. SHRI SHYAMAL
CHAKRABORTY: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been a substantial decline in employment
growth from 2004-05 to 2009-10;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
slowdown has been most severe in case of
female workers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
